scientific_integrity: Analytical proof uses standard smooth center manifolds and discrete Gronwall. Symbolic identities and finite numerical checks corroborate but do not replace the infinite-time and detuning-limit arguments. No independent scientific validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Local near a degenerate wave zero for fixed 0<mu<1 and 0<C<=1. Detuning time convergence is on finite scaled intervals with bounded scaled memory. Does not classify global walker dynamics, experimental droplets, or the simultaneous mu->1 limit; bibliographic priority remains subject to independent assessment.
title: Critical fifth-order relaxation and a detuning-scale gradient law for a walking-droplet map
